description: [Free] Names a product, logo, packaging, place, vehicle or UI screen from reference images so films keep it identical. Generated pictures take it in data.objects (clips, stills, insets, generate_asset) next to a character; image, gallery, pricing and compare cards draw it from data.object with its name and price.

description.description: One line added to every prompt that names it.

metadata.description: {price, currency (ISO 4217), brand, sku, url}. A price is drawn on pricing/compare/image cards.

name.description: The object's name, e.g. "Aurora watch". Scenes name it.

refs.description: 1-6 reference images, best first: asset ids (list_assets) or media URLs on this account.

site_url.description: Scope it to one of your sites.

source_url.description: Where it comes from (a product page). Attribution only.

name: create_object
title: Create a reusable object
